classification.difficultyReason: Use equal interior angles of a regular pentagon to form and solve a linear equation.

content.prompt: $ABCDE$ is a regular pentagon. Work out the value of $x$.

spec.description: Unshaded regular pentagon with A and B on the bottom edge, C upper right, D at the top and E upper left; interior angle at C has an arc and expression label. Ordinary source strokes are rendered black.
spec.mathematics: ABCDE is regular, so each interior angle is equal. The angle at C is (10x−6)°.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given expression is visible; no solved value is included.

answer.worked:
Angle sum of the pentagon:
$$\begin{align*}S&=180(5-2)\\S&=540^{\circ}\end{align*}$$
The five interior angles are equal.
$$\begin{align*}5(10x-6)&=540\\50x-30&=540\\50x&=570\\x&=11.4\end{align*}$$
